name: hardhat-multibaas-plugin-sample-v3
description: Sample Hardhat v3 project for hardhat-multibaas-plugin

scripts.deploy:metacoin: HARDHAT_NETWORK=development npx hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/MetaCoinModule.ts
scripts.deploy:greeter: HARDHAT_NETWORK=development npx hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/GreeterModule.ts
scripts.deploy:link:greeter: HARDHAT_NETWORK=development npx hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/LinkedGreeterModule.ts
scripts.deploy:proxy:greeter: HARDHAT_NETWORK=development npx hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/ProxiedGreeterModule.ts
scripts.deploy:all: npx hardhat clean && npm run deploy:metacoin && npm run deploy:greeter && npm run deploy:link:greeter && npm run deploy:proxy:greeter
